description: List the DNS records of a domain your workspace registered through Last Price. locked marks the records the storefront needs. A domain bought elsewhere is refused: manage its DNS where it was bought. Needs a Last Price credential with workspace settings read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

domain_id.description: The domain id, from list_storefronts or add_storefront_domain.

name: list_storefront_dns_records
